taxonomy.name: Musical Noise & Phase Inconsistency
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: High-frequency chirping, metallic phase artifacts, or swirling watery timbre in separated stems.
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: STFT phase cancellation or time-frequency mask discontinuities in Demucs/TasNet latent space.
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Apply Wiener filtering post-masking and smooth spectrogram magnitude thresholds with an energy floor.

taxonomy.name: Phantom Voice Channel (Over-Allocation)
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: A single active speaker is artificially split into two isolated tracks, one containing muffled echoes.
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: Fixed source count K=2 forced onto single-speaker monologue recordings.
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Single-speaker bypass detection (--bypass-separation) and energy ratio thresholding (<-40 dB relative to peak).

taxonomy.name: Severe Acoustic Bleed-Through
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: Stem 1 retains loud residual background vocals from Speaker 2 during high overlap (>50%).
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: Acoustic overlap complexity exceeds separation receptive field; negative SI-SDR improvement.
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Cascaded multi-pass separation or fallback to direct mixture diarization with overlap masking.

taxonomy.name: Speaker Ping-Ponging (Label Oscillation)
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: A continuous uninterrupted sentence is rapidly fragmented into alternating SPEAKER_00 / SPEAKER_01 labels.
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: Sliding window step duration too short (<0.5s) combined with natural pitch/formant inflections.
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Temporal boundary hysteresis, minimum turn-duration constraint (1.2s), and collar masking (0.25s).

taxonomy.name: Eigengap Cluster Collapse (K=1 Underestimation)
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: Two distinct conversational speakers are lumped into a single SPEAKER_00 identity.
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: Affinity matrix Laplacian eigenvalues lack sharp gap due to room reverberation or low SNR (<10 dB).
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Enforce minimum speaker prior (K_min=2) when Stage 1 detects multiple distinct acoustic sources.

taxonomy.name: CTC Silence Repetition Loop
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: The ASR engine outputs the same Hindi word repeatedly (e.g., 'है है है है') over background static.
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) blank-token failure during unvoiced or reverberant audio slices.
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Energy-based VAD trimming before ASR decoding and repetition deduplication filters.

taxonomy.name: Devanagari Unicode & Matra Inconsistency
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: Phonetically correct Hindi words score artificially high WER due to Nukta or ZWJ glyph divergence.
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: Mismatch between CTC character vocabulary canonicalization and reference Unicode encoding.
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Strict IndicTextNormalizer NFKC normalization and nukta canonicalization before evaluation.

taxonomy.name: Code-Switched Token Deletion
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: English technical loanwords (e.g., 'rehab', 'fitness test') omitted or severely distorted into Hindi homophones.
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: Monolingual Hindi acoustic prior suppressing Latin token emissions.
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Bilingual hybrid vocabulary decoding (IndicWav2Vec Hindi/English acoustic bundle).

taxonomy.name: Numerical & Rate Extrapolation (Hallucination)
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: LLM invents specific prices, interest rates, or percentages not spoken in the acoustic transcript.
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: Autoregressive next-token completion hallucinating missing financial details on rural audio prompts.
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Explicit Negative Constraint Guardrail 1 (Rule 2) + Automated Factual Hallucination Auditor.

taxonomy.name: Dialogue Speaker Misattribution
taxonomy.observable_phenomenon: A statement uttered by Speaker 1 is attributed to Speaker 2 in the executive summary.
taxonomy.algorithmic_root_cause: Loose context window attention failing to track speaker prefixes across fragmented turns.
taxonomy.mitigation_strategy: Strict Pydantic schema validation requiring explicit speaker attribution keys aligned to Contract 3.
